Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to disambiguate the search results for "René Poupardin" upon seeing the initial conflicting data (specifically the snippet showing "1994" in the second turn). Instead of halting to verify the correct historical figure (born 1874) against the modern individual or the erroneous snippet, the Planner continued to instruct the WebSurfer to run the exact same search queries repeatedly without changing the strategy or explicitly verifying the identity of the person being searched. This lack of critical analysis and failure to stop the cycle of redundant, unverified searches led to the model eventually hallucinating or misinterpreting the age difference based on incomplete or conflicting data, rather than definitively confirming the 1874 birth date before concluding who was younger. The Planner's instructions were repetitive and lacked the necessary directive to resolve the identity conflict immediately.
